full_prompt_en: A square naturalistic oil painting shows a large dark buffalo standing in an open field of dry grass beneath a broad cloudy sky. The horizon lies low, just above the lower third, and a nearly level band of distant land fades into muted gray behind the animal. Tall, ocher-colored stalks and pale seed heads fill the foreground, partly concealing its legs. The buffalo stands slightly right of center with its body turned diagonally away to the right and its heavy head angled left toward the viewer. Its shaggy black-brown coat is modeled with short dark strokes and softer rubbed passages, with warmer highlights following the rounded shoulder and back. Two thick pale horns rise from either side of the head and sweep outward before curling upward; their rough ivory surfaces create the brightest clear accents on the animal. The broad forehead, small dark eye, heavy muzzle, and dark ear are visible beneath them. Its chest and near foreleg sink into the tangle of grass, while the far side of the body merges into shadow. Above, a large cream-gray cloud mound occupies the upper right. Darker gray clouds stretch across the upper left and middle sky, leaving a few softer pale openings. Near the upper left, one dark bird flies with wings extended. Two smaller birds cross the middle-left distance, one catching light underneath and the other reduced to a darker mark. The wide empty air around the buffalo gives its compact mass room to dominate without crowding the frame. Fine brushwork distinguishes the animal's coarse hair from the thin brittle grasses and the diffuse cloud edges. Soft daylight enters through breaks in the sky from the upper right, touching the horns, upper back, and pale grass, while the underside of the body and the near ground remain dark. Shadows are broad and subdued rather than sharply cast. The overall composition is steady and monumental, placing a heavy dark form against sweeping gray clouds and an expansive field of tawny grass.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形自然主义油画呈现一头大型深色水牛站在干草原上，头顶铺着辽阔多云的天空。地平线很低，位于下方三分之一稍上，一道近乎水平的远处土地在动物身后退成灰色。赭色高草茎与浅色穗头填满前景，部分遮住它的腿。水牛略偏右站立，身体沿斜线向右后方转去，沉重的头则朝左侧观者方向偏转。黑褐色粗毛由短促深笔触和柔擦区域塑形，较暖的亮色沿圆肩和背部延伸。两只厚重浅色角从头的两侧升起，向外伸展后卷向上方；粗糙的象牙色表面成为动物身上最明亮清晰的重音。宽额、小而深的眼睛、厚重鼻吻与深色耳朵都在角下可见。胸部与近侧前腿沉入纠结草丛，身体远侧则融入阴影。上方，一大团奶油灰云占据右上天空。较深灰云横过左上与中部，只留下几处柔浅的空隙。左上附近，一只深色鸟展开翅膀飞过。另两只较小的鸟掠过中左侧远处，其中一只下侧接光，另一只缩成更暗的笔痕。水牛周围宽裕的空域让紧凑的身体主导画面，却不显拥挤。细密笔触区分动物粗毛、纤细脆草与漫散云边。柔和日光从右上方云隙进入，触及角、背部和浅色草，身体下侧与近处地面保持深暗。阴影宽而低调，没有锐利投影。整体构图稳定且宏大，将沉重深色形体置于横扫的灰云和辽阔黄褐草野前。
style_prompt_en: The naturalistic oil painting models solid, weighty forms with controlled tonal transitions and many small tactile strokes. A low-key range of charcoal brown, weathered gray, tawny ocher, and pale cream keeps the image earthy and restrained. Coarse dark textures contrast with fine dry linear marks and softly blended atmospheric masses. Broad cloud shadow covers much of the field, while selective diffuse light catches raised edges and pale surfaces. Open space surrounds the principal mass, giving stillness and scale to the composition. Foreground marks remain crisp enough to feel fibrous; distant bands flatten and soften toward the horizon. The overall effect is dignified and quiet, with physical texture and weather carrying the drama rather than saturated color.
style_prompt_zh: 这种自然主义油画以受控明暗过渡和大量细小、有触感的笔触塑造结实沉重的形体。炭褐、风化灰、黄褐赭和浅奶油色构成低调色域，使画面质朴克制。粗糙深色肌理与纤细枯干的线状痕迹、柔和晕合的大气色团形成对比。宽阔云影覆盖大部分画面，选择性的漫散光照到凸起边缘与浅色表面。开放空间围绕主形体，赋予构图静止感和尺度。前景笔痕足够清晰，能感到纤维质地；远处色带则朝地平线压平变柔。整体效果庄重安静，戏剧性来自实体肌理与天气，而非饱和色彩。
theme_en: A dark horned buffalo in dry grass under a clouded sky
theme_zh: 多云天空下站在枯草中的深色长角水牛
name: Rosa Bonheur
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
